name: Database
description: Opens a SQLite database of the project read-only: its tables with their counts, a table's structure and rows with sort and paging. Values stay on screen unless you hand the table and a question to an agent.
author: Hangar

gallery.permissionsSummary: Runs four declared commands, a Node script that opens a SQLite file of the workspace read-only (never any SQL of your own) to list databases, tables, a structure and a page of rows; keeps your last choice in the kit's own data folder; and sends a table and your question, never its rows, to an agent of the workspace only when you click.

list.description: Lists the SQLite files of the workspace, found by their extension and checked by their header. Reads nothing else.

tables.description: Lists the tables of one SQLite file of the workspace with their row counts. The file is opened read-only.

path.description: The database's path, from the workspace folder

schema.description: Shows the columns and indexes of one table. The file is opened read-only.

path.description: The database's path, from the workspace folder

rows.description: Reads one page of a table, at most 200 rows, with long text cut. The file is opened read-only.

path.description: The database's path, from the workspace folder

sort.description: The number of the column to sort by, from 1; 0 for none

chars.description: How many characters of a text value, at most 100000

path.description: A SQLite file of the workspace to open, as a path from the workspace folder
